data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Thank you for reporting this sync issue. We understand that files modified in the web app are not updating on your desktop client following the v4.2 update. To resolve this, please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk (macOS), and then reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section. This typically resolves these types of synchronization problems. [T-5791] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
